transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess… my talking gets mixed up. I try to explain something and it comes out all over—like the keys, then jail, then a prayer rug, then chess pieces. People say they can’t follow me.
Have you been feeling unusually high or euphoric lately?
Yeah… sometimes. I get real up, like I feel big, powerful, and I’ll laugh and talk loud with anybody. But if somebody starts questioning me, I can get mad fast… shout over nothing, I guess.
Do you believe things that other people say aren’t true, like having special powers or being chosen for a special mission?

Sometimes I think… I can fix the whole building myself, tell the bosses how it should really be run. Like I see things different. Maybe people would know me around town for it. I don’t know… it feels true when I’m like that.
Do you ever hear voices when no one else is there?
Yeah… sometimes. I hear a man’s voice, like from the vents or the mop closet. Says my name, or says I ruined everything. It sounds… real, like he’s right there.
Do you hear that man’s voice even when you’re not feeling especially up or powerful?

Yeah… it’s not only when I’m all worked up. There’s been calmer weeks, where I wasn’t feeling high or real low, and I still heard him… in the vents. More than a couple weeks. I also thought people in the building were… signaling about me. I don’t really like talking about it.
Have there been times when you felt very down or depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?

Yeah… there’s been stretches like that. I don’t know how long exactly, but… on bad days I just sit on the edge of the bed after morning prayer, feeling heavy. Empty. Like there’s no point cleaning myself up or going outside.
Have you ever had a period of at least a week when you felt unusually high or powerful most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah… I’ve had times like that. Like I feel… bigger than myself, powerful, and I’ll be laughing and talking loud with everybody. But if somebody questions me, even a little, I can snap. Start shouting over nothing.
Was there ever a time when the voice and the feeling that people were signaling about you lasted at least two weeks when you were not feeling especially high or depressed?

Yeah… that did happen. There were calmer weeks, not really high or down, and it still went on. More than two weeks, I think… hearing him in the vents, and thinking people in the building were signaling about me. I don’t like getting into it much.
Over the whole time you’ve been having these problems, have you spent most of that time feeling depressed?
Not most of the whole time, no. But those heavy, hopeless stretches… if I add them up, maybe around seven months or so. Hard to say exact.
Looking back over the whole time you’ve had these problems, would you say you were depressed for more than half of that time?
No… I don’t think it was more than half. The bad, hopeless times… all together maybe around seven months. Hard to be exact.
Looking back over the whole time you’ve had these problems, have you spent more than half of that time feeling unusually high, powerful, or energized?
Yeah… probably more than half, if I’m being honest. A lot of the time I was keyed up, talking too much, taking on cleaning stuff I couldn’t really finish… just driven, like I couldn’t slow down.
Have there also been times when the voice and the feeling that people were signaling about you happened only while you were feeling unusually high or depressed?

Not only then, no. There were… calmer weeks too, when I wasn’t really high or sunk down bad, and it still happened. More than a couple weeks, I’d say. I still heard the man in the vents and thought people in the building were signaling about me.
Was there ever a full month when you heard the voice or felt people were signaling about you while you were not feeling especially high or depressed?

I’m not sure it was a full month. I don’t want to say that if I’m not sure. But there were calmer weeks, more than two weeks, where I wasn’t especially high or real depressed… and I still heard the man in the vents and thought people were signaling about me.
Was there ever a full month when you were hearing the voice or thought people were signaling about you while you were not feeling especially high or depressed?

I don’t know about a full month. I can’t say that for sure. There were calmer weeks, though… more than two, when I wasn’t really high or real low, and I still heard the man in the vents and thought people in the building were signaling about me.
At any point, did the voice or the feeling that people were signaling about you continue for a full month while you were not feeling especially high or depressed?

I can’t really say it was a full month. I know there were calmer weeks… more than two weeks, where I wasn’t especially high or real depressed, and it still kept going—the man in the vents, and thinking people in the building were signaling about me.
Thinking about a time when you were not feeling especially high or depressed, did the voice or the feeling that people were signaling about you continue for a full month?

I don’t know if it was a full month. I just know there were calmer weeks—more than two—where I wasn’t really high or real depressed, and I still heard him in the vents… and still thought people in the building were signaling.
Have you ever had a stretch of at least one week when you felt unusually high, powerful, or full of energy most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah… I’ve had times like that. Like I felt really high, powerful, had a lot of energy. I’d laugh a lot, talk loud with everybody. But if somebody questioned me, I could snap… shout over something small.
When you were not feeling especially high or depressed, did the voice or the feeling that people were signaling about you ever last a full month?

I don’t know about a full month. There were calmer weeks, yeah… more than two weeks, when I wasn’t real high or real down, and I still heard the man in the vents. I still thought people in the building were signaling about me.
At any time, did the voice continue for a full month when you were not feeling especially high or depressed?

I can’t say it was a full month. I know there were calmer weeks—more than two—where I wasn’t really high or real depressed, and I still heard him in the vents… still felt like people were signaling about me.
Have you ever had the voice or the feeling that people were signaling about you for a full month while you were not feeling especially high or depressed?

I don’t know if I’d call it a full month. There were calmer weeks… more than two weeks, where I wasn’t especially high or real depressed, and I still heard the man in the vents. Still felt like people in the building were signaling about me.
